TDA.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable Directional Animation
TDA.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Globally enable or disable directional token animations for this world.
TDA.Settings.AutoDetect.Name: Auto-Detect Animation Sources
TDA.Settings.AutoDetect.Hint: Automatically look for an index.json or directional files (N.webm, NE.webm, ...) next to the token's texture, even when no source is configured on the token.
TDA.Settings.DefaultIdleBehavior.Name: Default Idle Behavior
TDA.Settings.DefaultIdleBehavior.Hint: What tokens should display once movement ends, unless overridden per token.
TDA.Settings.DefaultMirror.Name: Mirror Missing Directions
TDA.Settings.DefaultMirror.Hint: When a source only provides one horizontal side (e.g. E, NE, SE), reuse those textures horizontally flipped for the missing side (W, NW, SW).
TDA.Settings.PreloadAll.Name: Preload Directional Textures
TDA.Settings.PreloadAll.Hint: Preload every directional texture when a scene loads to avoid flicker on the first turn. Disable on low-memory clients.
TDA.Settings.DebugLogging.Name: Debug Logging
TDA.Settings.DebugLogging.Hint: Print verbose directional-animation diagnostics to the console.
TDA.TokenConfig.Enabled.Label: Enable Directional Animation
TDA.TokenConfig.Enabled.Hint: Change this token's texture to face its movement direction.
TDA.TokenConfig.Source.Label: Animation Source
TDA.TokenConfig.Source.Hint: Path to an index.json, a directory containing N.webm / NE.webm / ..., or a template such as tokens/goblin/{dir}.webm. Leave empty to auto-detect from the token texture.
TDA.TokenConfig.IdleBehavior.Label: Idle Behavior
TDA.TokenConfig.IdleBehavior.Hint: What this token displays when it stops moving.
TDA.TokenConfig.IdleSource.Label: Idle Texture
TDA.TokenConfig.IdleSource.Hint: Texture shown while idle when Idle Behavior is set to "custom". If the animation source defines an idle/token entry, it is used as a fallback.
TDA.TokenConfig.Mirror.Label: Mirror Missing Directions
TDA.TokenConfig.Mirror.Hint: Horizontally flip E / NE / SE textures to cover W / NW / SW (or vice versa) when only five directions are provided.
TDA.Notifications.SourceNotResolved: Token Directional Animation: could not resolve directional textures from "{source}".
TDA.Notifications.IndexParseError: Token Directional Animation: failed to parse index.json at "{path}".
